generic_sampling_rules.text_columns: Sample from a per-column pool built from observed distinct values plus fresh synthetic values; 20-50% of rows reuse an existing value (duplicates for DISTINCT), the rest are fresh. For each LIKE/equality literal in per_column_exceptions, force-include the literal, one near-variant (one char substituted/appended, or case-flipped), and a prefix/suffix extension in the pool so each appears at least once per instance.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_columns: Sample integers uniformly within the column range; for boundary targets include each listed literal and one step on each side (step = 1 unless stated).
generic_sampling_rules.nullable_columns: Each nullable column gets NULL in a share of rows matching the compact database share (5-30% for COUNT columns, 0% for NOT NULL); at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance. NULL is a value: planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule.
generic_sampling_rules.join_columns: For FK columns, generate parent rows first; assign child FK values from parent keys, plus a share of child rows with NULL FK (where nullable) and a share of parent rows with no children.
generic_sampling_rules.order_tie_columns: For ORDER/LIMIT columns, plant ties on the actual aggregate (COUNT(*) and COUNT(tags.tag)) at the listed ranks by controlling the number of tags per torrents group so that two groups share the same COUNT at rank 1 and rank ~100.
